name: @pipeworx/mcp-fyyd

tools.name: search_podcasts
tools.description: fyyd, the open podcast directory — search podcast shows by title term, optionally restricted to a language code, up to 30 per page. Returns each show's fyyd podcast id, title, author, description, RSS feed URL, artwork and episode count. Answers which podcast shows exist under a name and where the RSS feed is.

tools.name: search_episodes
tools.description: fyyd, the open podcast directory — search individual podcast episodes, matching the term against episode titles and show-note descriptions, optionally filtered by language. Returns each episode's fyyd id, title, description, publication date, duration, audio enclosure URL and its parent podcast id. Answers which podcast episode covered a subject and where to listen to it.

tools.name: get_podcast_by_url
tools.description: Resolve an RSS feed URL to its fyyd id.

tools.name: top_podcasts
tools.description: Return the most popular podcasts on fyyd, optionally filtered by category slug and language code, with up to 30 results per call.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fyyd forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fyyd pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
